description: Search currently open Government of Canada tender notices from CanadaBuys (requests for proposal, standing offer and supply arrangement requests, requests for information, advance contract award notices). Use it to find bidding opportunities by keyword, buyer, category, commodity code, delivery region or closing date. Returns short summaries; call get_tender for full details. With no arguments it lists the tenders closing soonest. Covers federal organizations only.

buyer.description: Words from the contracting or end-user organization name, in either language, e.g. "National Defence".

category.description: Procurement categories; a notice matching any listed category is returned.

closing_after.description: Only tenders closing on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

closing_before.description: Only tenders closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

include_past_deadline.description: The source lists some notices as open after their closing date has passed. They are hidden unless this is true.

match.description: Whether a notice must contain all query terms or any of them. An explicit OR in the query always applies.

notice_type.description: Text contained in the notice type, e.g. "Request for Proposal", "Request for Information", "Standing Offer".

published_after.description: Only tenders published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Keywords searched in titles, descriptions, commodity names and buyer names. Words match in English and French, ignoring case and accents. Use "double quotes" for an exact phrase, a trailing * for a prefix (engineer*), and uppercase OR between alternatives.

region.description: Text contained in a region of delivery, e.g. "Ontario", "National Capital Region", "British Columbia". Nationwide tenders are listed under "Canada" and are not returned for a provincial filter.

sort.description: Defaults to relevance when a query is given, otherwise closing_soonest.

unspsc.description: UNSPSC commodity code or prefix. A segment or family code such as 43000000 or 4323 also matches every code beneath it.

name: search_tenders
title: Search open federal tenders
